# Scenario: nginx conf rollback after failed ACME issue.
# 1) Deploy port-only HTTP (cert none) → conf listens on inbound port.
# 2) Switch to domain + prod ACME against 429 stub → new conf is written then restored.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: port-only baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# Cycle 1: port-only, no ACME.
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'listen 9999' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! grep 'server_name e2e-rollback.apinfra.test' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# Cycle 2: domain + prod; conf changes (reload-before-issue), ACME rate-limits, conf restored.
acme-ratelimit-start
chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

cd git-repo
cp ../settings.domain-prod.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: switch to domain ACME prod'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'rate limited domain=e2e-rollback.apinfra.test'
stderr 'rolled back those service confs'
stderr 'done duration='

# Pre-cycle port conf must be restored (not left as domain/ssl live vhost).
grep 'listen 9999' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! grep 'server_name e2e-rollback.apinfra.test' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! grep 'ssl/live/e2e-rollback.apinfra.test' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

acme-ratelimit-stop

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.provider=letsencrypt
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://localhost:18080/directory
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://localhost:18080/directory

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.domain-prod.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-rollback.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
echo '127.0.0.1'

-- .env --
